purpose: Evaluate whether the already-frozen MRI candidate-conditioned HARM rankings translate to patient-level 3D deployment utility on PROMISE12, without any new fitting, score reversal, target calibration, action tuning, or coverage optimization.

panel.patient_3d_dice: pooled voxel Dice from summed TP/FP/FN within each patient x family x action cell

primary_operating_point.selection: exact lowest-risk 50% within each family x action cell
primary_operating_point.rounding_rule: k = floor(n_cell * 0.50); ties broken by stable row key only
primary_operating_point.why_fixed: pre-frozen matched-budget operating point; not selected from deployment outcomes
primary_operating_point.bootstrap_selection: selection labels fixed before bootstrap; do not rerank within bootstrap

coverage_curve.selection: exact lowest-risk k within each family x action cell
coverage_curve.prohibition: do not select or report a best coverage as a tuned operating point

random_reference.matching: same exact k per family x action cell as the compared gating policy

paired_patient_bootstrap.resample_contract: resample patients and retain every available family x action slice row for each sampled patient occurrence

forbidden: representation fusion after viewing utility outcomes
asset_gate_before_metrics: Run B6_P06A asset-binding audit. New patient utility metrics may be computed only after the audit identifies exact frozen score/outcome/count or mask assets.
